name: Ca hong
summary: Cá hồng is a fish from the rafts on Đầm Lập An, served to guests on the lagoon.
origin: Lang Co, on Đầm Lập An. Nhân Dân, 5 July 2024, for the fish in the lagoon. Viện Kinh tế xã hội Hà Nội, 1 October 2016, for guests eating it.
howToEat: Eat it on the lagoon, from the fish raised under the rafts.
seoTitle: Ca hong in Lang Co — a lagoon fish
seoDescription: Cá hồng is a fish from the rafts on Đầm Lập An, served to guests on the lagoon.
